Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the primary distinction between hydraulics and pneumatics, incorrectly choosing option A by claiming pneumatics are not under pressure. Both systems operate under pressure; the fundamental (definitional) difference is the working medium—liquids vs. gases—making option B correct. The Planner dismissed this and prematurely concluded the task without verification.
